title: Dùng cái này cùng thuốc của tôi có an toàn không?
englishTitle: Is this safe with my medicine?
pronunciation: Dung cai nay cung thuoc cua toi co an toan khong
summary: For asking a pharmacist or clinician about mixing a new medicine with what you already take.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Show your current medicine, prescription, or translated note before you take the new item.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Hold both medicines visible while you ask. Wait for a yes, no, dosage change, or doctor referral.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Dùng cái này means using this; cùng thuốc của tôi means with my medicine; có an toàn không asks is it safe.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Doctor, pharmacy, and nearest-pharmacy cards help if the safety question needs a professional handoff.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Pharmacies, clinics, and hotel medical desks are the right places for this interaction check.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Medicine names are easy to mishear. Showing the package or active ingredient matters more than repeating the phrase.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Headache, stomach pain, motion-sickness medicine, allergy, and diarrhea cards cover nearby health needs.
